title: Scikit-learn — Final Knowledge and Portfolio Assessment

recommended_settings.attempts: Follow CodeLeaf exam policy; this blueprint does not change live attempt limits.

assessment_type: Protected single-choice knowledge check, practical exercise portfolio, and human-reviewed capstone.
outcomes: Explain the Scikit-learn estimator workflow and input conventions.
Prepare features and build leakage-safe pipelines.
Choose regression, classification, ensemble, and unsupervised approaches that fit the problem.
Select appropriate validation strategies, metrics, and hyperparameter-search procedures.
Inspect models and document assumptions, failure cases, artifact trust, and production limits.

topic_distribution.topic: Feature engineering, unsupervised learning, text and specialization
Persistence, deployment, testing and custom estimators

question_file_strategy: Each of the 188 lessons links a separate protected three-question knowledge-check set. This final bank is a draft 30-question sampling blueprint; an interactive timed exam and persisted attempts are not added by this content patch.
project_submission: The capstone requires human review. The reviewed CodeLeaf architecture does not provide a general-purpose secure Python execution service; do not execute arbitrary learner code inside the FastAPI process or production web container.
remediation_policy: Use missed outcomes to recommend relevant lessons and exercises. Publish only after technical accuracy, grading behavior, accessibility and security review.
